name: Ordering Width under Boolean Substitution
statement: For every nonempty outer class $C$ and proper nonempty test $T$, $\sigma(C\circ_iT)\leq\max\{\sigma(T),\sigma(T^{\mathrm c}),\sigma(C)+g(T)-1\}$. If both exclusive outer sections are nonempty, then $\sigma(C\circ_iT)\geq\max\{\sigma(C),\sigma(T),\sigma(T^{\mathrm c})\}$. No ampleness hypothesis is required.
proof: Order optimal test-side blocks along an optimal outer order. A predecessor in the current block has an inner witness of size at most $\sigma(T)+1$ or $\sigma(T^{\mathrm c})+1$. For a completed block, an outer witness that stays on the same side keeps the inner word; one that crosses the distinguished coordinate uses a contained crossing disagreement of size at most $g(T)$. Because the outer support then spends one coordinate on the split, the combined size is at most $\sigma(C)+g(T)$. Conditioning a crossing test edge and exclusive outside words recovers the three inputs, proving the lower bound.
comments: For an empty or full test, every nonempty output is one outer section times the inner cube and has that section's width.
